name: Gonti
aliases: Gonti, lord of the Night Market
description: Gonti is an immortal aetherborn crime lord of Ghirapur who rules its underworld and holds the title Night Minister.

description_citations.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 2: Antiquities" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Oct 2022.

summary.text: Gonti is an immortal aetherborn crime lord of Ghirapur who rules its underworld and holds the title Night Minister.

bio.text: Gonti's palace-like hideout hides stolen devices, and Gonti called the Consulate's curfew and confiscation a curse on the city.
Yahenni blackmailed Gonti with the secret of their manufactured heart, and Gonti revealed the renegades' safe house and tasked Yahenni with warning them to force them into action.

citations.text: "In the Dead of Night" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Nov 2016.

bio.text: Gonti admitted to Chandra that he had pushed the renegades to act and offered the contents of his storeroom for the insurrection.

authors: Nik Davidson, Kelly Digges, and Kimberly J. Kreines
citations.text: "Revolution Begins" by Nik Davidson, Kelly Digges, and Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jan 2017.

bio.text: In a flashback, Gonti held Saheeli captive, threatened to have her family executed, and coerced her into repairing his failing aether heart before revealing the threat was a test of faith.

status.text: As of the latest story Gonti is alive and serving as Night Minister who oversees the Grand Prix.

citations.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 2: Pit Stop" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2025.
"Aetherdrift | Episode 4: Little-Guy Shortcuts" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Gonti enlists Saheeli Rai to fix their aether heart, holding her family hostage, then reveals they were never in danger.
timeline.quote: the crime lord revealed that the Rais had never been in danger

citation.text: "Gonti", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The renegades attacked the Aether Hub and its personnel yielded.
timeline.quote: the renegades attacked the Aether Hub .

citation.text: "Pia Nalaar", section "Renegade Prime". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Yahenni hides Nived behind a stall and decides to find the renegades and the criminal's daughter, then seek Gonti's help.
timeline.quote: I need to find the renegades.

citation.text: "In the Dead of Night" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Nov 2016.

timeline.summary: Yahenni gets Nived home and reaches Gonti's palace-like hideout, where Gonti is bathing in aether attar, a metal lump visible on their chest.
timeline.quote: Gonti sits submerged, their face covered with a gilded mask.

citation.text: "In the Dead of Night" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Nov 2016.

timeline.summary: Yahenni blackmails Gonti with the secret of their manufactured heart, asking where Chandra and Pia Nalaar are hiding.
timeline.quote: "If you tell me where they are hiding, I will keep the secret of your manufactured heart to myself.

citation.text: "In the Dead of Night" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Nov 2016.

timeline.summary: Gonti realizes Yahenni is an essence drainer and reveals having employed two before.
timeline.quote: "Essence drainers are rare," Gonti replies, "I've only ever had two in my employment.

citation.text: "In the Dead of Night" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Nov 2016.

timeline.summary: Gonti reveals the renegades' safe house in the Statuary Garden and tasks Yahenni with warning them that the Consulate is coming, to force them into acting.
timeline.quote: You'll find the younger Nalaar and her associates in a safe house within the Statuary Garden.

citation.text: "In the Dead of Night" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Nov 2016.

timeline.summary: Pia brings Chandra to an aetherborn club protected by Gonti where sympathetic inventors gather, asking Chandra to give the speech to spark rebellion.
timeline.quote: Chandra, I want you to do it.

authors: Nik Davidson, Kelly Digges, and Kimberly J. Kreines
citation.text: "Revolution Begins" by Nik Davidson, Kelly Digges, and Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jan 2017.

timeline.summary: An aetherborn emissary calms the crowd and leads Pia, Chandra and others down a secret tunnel to meet Gonti.
timeline.quote: revealing a tunnel and a descending set of stairs.

authors: Nik Davidson, Kelly Digges, and Kimberly J. Kreines
citation.text: "Revolution Begins" by Nik Davidson, Kelly Digges, and Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jan 2017.

timeline.summary: Chandra accuses Gonti of betraying them, but Gonti says he pushed them to act and offers the contents of his storeroom for the insurrection.
timeline.quote: I believe I have what you'll need for your little insurrection.

authors: Nik Davidson, Kelly Digges, and Kimberly J. Kreines
citation.text: "Revolution Begins" by Nik Davidson, Kelly Digges, and Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 2 Jan 2017.

timeline.summary: Gonti sees the revolution as beneficial to his enterprises.
timeline.quote: all our enterprises can benefit from this little revolution

citation.text: Gonti's Machinations (Aether Revolt, 2017), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Saheeli wakes tied to a chair in a room of stolen art as Gonti, who knows everything about her family, addresses her.
timeline.quote: she woke up tied to a chair in this place.

citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 2: Antiquities" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Gonti reveals their cracked-stone chest and failing aether heart and demands Saheeli repair it.
timeline.quote: It has begun to fail.

citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 2: Antiquities" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Gonti threatens to have Saheeli's family executed, starting with her mother, and shows her mother's bracelet.
timeline.quote: If I don't send word in the allotted time, their instructions are to execute everyone.

citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 2: Antiquities" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Saheeli repairs Gonti's cracked silver filament, learning Gonti is immortal, and Gonti reveals the threat was a test of faith.
timeline.quote: A small fracture in the filament had developed over time

citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 2: Antiquities" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: After the New Phyrexian Invasion, Gonti pressures their way into a post as a Multiverse emissary.
timeline.quote: Gonti was able to pressure their way into an official post as one of the plane's Multiverse emissaries.

citation.text: "Gonti", section "Thunder Junction". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gonti works from a satellite office on Thunder Junction on two tracks.
timeline.quote: Gonti worked along two tracks.

citation.text: "Gonti", section "Thunder Junction". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A radio report announces the Grand Prix winner will claim the Aetherspark.
timeline.quote: The winner of the Ghirapur Grand Prix gets to claim this once-in-a-lifetime chance at ultimate power and freedom.

citation.work: Aetherdrift | Episode 1: The Dashing and the Desperate
citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 1: The Dashing and the Desperate" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Mohar hurls the radio across the room at the mention of Gonti.
timeline.quote: The moment Gonti's name is announced on the radio, Mohar hurls it across the room.

citation.work: Aetherdrift | Episode 1: The Dashing and the Desperate
citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 1: The Dashing and the Desperate" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Night Minister Gonti addresses the crowd as grand marshal.
timeline.quote: We thank all of you for attending.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 2: Pit Stop" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Suraj reveals Gonti approved a cheaper copper alloy for the platforms instead of steel.
timeline.quote: a cheaper, more quickly made copper alloy instead of steel

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 2: Pit Stop" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Gonti fires the signal flare to start the Grand Prix.
timeline.quote: Gonti fires the flare.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 2: Pit Stop" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Gonti becomes night minister of Ghirapur as a reward for help during two revolutions.
timeline.quote: The title of night minister was offered as a reward for their help during two consecutive revolutions

citation.text: "Gonti", section "Ghirapur Grand Prix". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.quote: And he's already hired you for security.
